gui.forms.editor.newSub: A command to run on one of your hosts
gui.forms.editor.editSub: Saved to profiles.toml; the previous file is backed up first
gui.forms.editor.name: Name
gui.forms.editor.idHelp: Used by shortcuts: waylauncher://launch/{id}. Letters, digits and “-”.
gui.forms.editor.idHelpFixed: Used by shortcuts: waylauncher://launch/{id}. Letters, digits and “-”. The ID can’t change once created.
gui.forms.editor.commandHelp: Each argument is passed as-is; nothing is evaluated by a local shell. Press Space or Return after each one, and use quotes for an argument that contains spaces.
gui.forms.editor.cwdPlaceholder: optional, an absolute path on the host
gui.forms.editor.envHelp: Not for passwords or tokens: profiles are plain text files.
gui.forms.editor.instSingle: Single: opening it again focuses its window
gui.forms.editor.instMultiple: Multiple: “New window” starts another; opening it again follows Settings
gui.forms.host.sub: The machine your applications run on
gui.forms.host.sshHelp: Host keys are checked against your known_hosts and never accepted automatically. No passwords: use ssh keys.
gui.forms.host.removeBody: This removes it from profiles.toml. Applications that still use it must be removed or moved first.
gui.forms.settings.title: Settings
gui.forms.settings.themeHelp: Applies to the window and its menus.
gui.forms.settings.glassHelp: The window material. “Follow system” uses the regular glass: apps can’t read the Liquid Glass slider of System Settings.
gui.forms.settings.menuBarHelp: Pinned and running apps, one click away.
gui.forms.settings.dock: Show running Linux apps in the Dock
gui.forms.settings.dockHelp: Each running app gets its own Dock icon with a running dot. Clicking it brings Cocoa-Way forward; Quit from its menu stops the app. The windows still belong to Cocoa-Way, so its own icon stays.
gui.forms.settings.reopen: Opening an app that is already running
gui.forms.settings.singleHelp: Focus its window. Until Cocoa-Way can report and activate windows, Waylauncher brings Cocoa-Way forward instead.
gui.forms.settings.multiHelp: “New window” on an application always starts another instance.
gui.forms.settings.stillRunningHelp: Quitting closes every running Linux app: Waypipe sessions can’t be kept or reattached. Unsaved work in them is lost. Cocoa-Way keeps running.
gui.forms.settings.noChild: Count “No child processes” as a normal close
gui.forms.settings.noChildHelp: waypipe-darwin can exit with code 1 when a window closes normally. With this on, that shows as “Exited normally” with no alert.
gui.forms.settings.profiles:
Profiles: {path}
Edits keep a backup of the previous file. Passwords and keys are never stored.
gui.forms.settings.noChildLabel: Count No child processes as a normal close
